headline: WNBA Finals Game 5: Valkyries and Dream clash in winner-take-all decider
whyCareReason: The championship is on the line at Chase Center as the expansion Valkyries aim to complete a fairytale inaugural season against the hungry Dream.
teaser: TONIGHT: Game 5 at Chase Center in San Francisco (20:00 ET). Series tied 2-2. Winner hoists the WNBA trophy.
story: The 2026 WNBA Finals reach a dramatic conclusion on Monday night, 26 October, as the Golden State Valkyries host the Atlanta Dream in a decisive Game 5 at Chase Center in San Francisco. After fighting off elimination with a gritty 67-62 road victory in Game 4 behind Gabby Williams and Kiah Stokes, the expansion Valkyries have a chance to secure the greatest inaugural season in modern sports history in front of their home fans. The Dream, led by All-Stars Rhyne Howard and Angel Reese, will look to regroup and capture their franchise's first-ever WNBA championship.
stakes: Winner takes the 2026 WNBA Championship trophy in front of a sellout Chase Center crowd.
rivalryAngle: First-year expansion team Valkyries host veteran contender Atlanta Dream in an electrifying final showdown.
funFacts: Game 5 is winner-take-all with the series tied 2-2.
Previous scores: Game 1 Valkyries 68-64; Game 2 Dream 79-65; Game 3 Dream 97-71; Game 4 Valkyries 67-62.
Tip-off scheduled for 20:00 ET / 17:00 PT at Chase Center in San Francisco.

keyPlayers.name: Gabby Williams
keyPlayers.hook: Scored team-high 17 points in Game 4 to force tonight's championship decider.

keyPlayers.name: Angel Reese
keyPlayers.hook: Seeks bounce-back performance after posting three straight double-doubles in Games 1 through 3.

keyPlayers.name: Rhyne Howard
keyPlayers.hook: Leading scorer for the Dream throughout the playoff postseason.
